module load gcc/4.9.2
module load matlab/2015b

cd /home/sliu104/MoCapGaussian/

# The matlab command is preserved. It is assumed that Matlab will automatically use the

# in 3 idle cores. To run 4 separate instances, each on its own core, you would need to
# wrap each command with 'flux run -n 1 ... &'.
matlab -nodisplay -nosplash -nodesktop -r "runMoCap_AA_AA_4()"

#!/bin/bash
 
#SBATCH -p serial                   # Send this job to the serial partition
#SBATCH -n 4                        # number of cores
#SBATCH -t 0-12:00                  # wall time (D-HH:MM)
#SBATCH -o slurm.%j.out             # STDOUT (%j = JobId)
#SBATCH -e slurm.%j.err             # STDERR (%j = JobId)
#SBATCH --mail-type=END,FAIL        # notifications for job done & fail
#SBATCH --mail-user=sliu104@asu.edu # send-to address

module load gcc/4.9.2
module load matlab/2015b
cd /home/sliu104/MoCapGaussian/
matlab -nodisplay -nosplash -nodesktop -r "runMoCap_AA_AA_4()"
